Sexual Offences Definitive Guideline 109
Effective from 1 April 2014
MENTAL DISORDER IMPEDING CHOICE: SEXUAL ACTIVITY IN THE PRESENCE OF OR CAUSING TO WATCH
Engaging in sexual activity in the
presence of a person with mental
disorder impeding choice
Sexual Offences Act 2003 (section 32)
Causing a person, with mental
disorder impeding choice,
to watch a sexual act
Sexual Offences Act 2003 (section 33)
Triable either way
Maximum: 10 years’ custody
Offence range: Community order – 6 years’ custody
For convictions on or after 3 December 2012 (irrespective of the date of commission of the
offence), these are specified offences for the purposes of section 226A (extended sentence for
certain violent or sexual offences) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003.
